think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range. 2) Check PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/force an alternate mode) rather than acting as an ordered numeric tuning parameter. 3) Determine whether any such value makes the knob perform a qualitatively different function (e.g., disables a feature) versus merely adjusting a threshold. 4) If a sentinel exists, mark as special and record the value; otherwise mark as not special.
